dedupe_keys.name: nczi slovakia health statistics thematic statistical outputs beds and hospitalisations health facilities and staff specialty activity and the health statistics yearbook

description: NCZI, Slovakia's National Health Information Centre, is the official producer of health statistics in the country. Its thematic statistical outputs are yearly publications by topic, each with tables: they include the network of health facilities, with the number of outpatient units, hospitals, beds, pharmacies and health worker posts; inpatient care, with beds, hospitalised patients, average length of stay and doctor and nurse posts; anaesthesiology and intensive care; COVID-19 hospitalisations; and specialty activities such as diabetology or drug treatment. An archive keeps earlier years, and a health statistics yearbook summarises them. Coverage is national, with regional breakdowns. The outputs are free and available to download from the NCZI site, in Slovak; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: outputs are separate publications per topic with their own table layouts, and facility-level detail is limited to what each topic reports. Simulation uses: sizing hospital beds, intensive care and workforce by region for surge planning, and tracking health system use during epidemics. Related records: GISCO healthcare services (data-gisco-healthcare-services-europe) map Slovak hospitals, and the WHO health infrastructure indicators (data-who-gho-health-infrastructure-indicators) give comparisons.
